name: X-Wing
model_likelihood: Population-specific additive linear regression with Gaussian errors; Jeffreys prior for residual variances.
prior: Annotation-dependent Gaussian horseshoe hierarchy with global phi, SNP-local psi_j, and category-by-population lambda; standard half-Cauchy priors on their square roots.
inference_algorithm: LOGODetect extension identifies locally correlated regions; block Gibbs sampling estimates SNP effects; summary-statistic repeated learning estimates mixing weights, averaged after normalization.
estimand: Posterior mean population-specific SNP effects; population-specific PRS and their weighted linear combination.
data_input: Multi-population GWAS summary statistics and population-matched LD reference panels.
tunable_settings: Scan LD-penalty theta candidate grid; maximum scanned region size C (2000 in analysis); number s of top positive regions (1000 in analysis); MCMC iterations and burn-in (1000 K and 500 K recommended); optional fixed phi grid {1E-6, 1E-4, 1E-2, 1}; repeated-learning count P and training/validation split.
